Hoenn Gyms

Like in Ruby & Sapphire, there are eight gyms to face through the Hoenn region. These gyms hold diffwerent puzzles to the ones that came before and the Gym Leaders have different teams for you to face.

Gym #1: Rustboro City

Location: Rustboro City
Gym Leader: Roxanne
Specialty: Rock-type
Reward: Stone Badge, TM39

Method:
The first gym challenge is a fairly simple gym with a path that lets you avoid trainers, yor you can battle them. At the end, you will face the Gym Leader Roxanne who utilises various Rock-type Pokémon making it an easy defeat if . If you win you get TM39 (Rock Tomb) and the Stone Badge. You can also use Cut outside of battle now.

Gym #2: Dewford Town

Location: Dewford Town
Gym Leader: Brawly
Specialty: Fighting-type
Reward: Knuckle Badge, TM08

Method:
Brawly's gym matches a simplar puzzle to in the original games but with a different layout. As you battle trainers, the gym will light up more allowing for you to find a way to face Brawly. Should you beat him you get TM08 (Bulk Up) and the Knuckle Badge. You can now use Flash to light up caves outside of battle now.

Gym #3: Mauville City

Location: Mauville City
Gym Leader: Wattson
Specialty: Electric-type
Reward: Dynamo Badge, TM34

Method:
The third gym is located in Mauville City and has a different iteration of the same puzzle as before where you need to make your way through a maze by hitting switches that change the direction of electric walls. Get to the end, defeating trainers along the way and you will find Wattson. If you win you get TM34 (Shock Wave), and the Dynamo Badge. Plus, you can also now use Rock Smash to destroy rocks in your way.

Gym #4: Lavaridge Town

Location: Lavaridge Town
Gym Leader: Flannery
Specialty: Fire-type
Reward: Heat Badge, TM50

Method:
The Lavaridge Gym is again a maze that has you going between two levels through various holes in a maze style, defeating trainers as you go. When you get to the end, you will find the Gym Leader, Flannery. If you win you get TM50 (Overheat) and the Heat Badge. You also now have access to Strength outside of battle now.

Gym #5: Petalburg City

Location: Petalburg City
Gym Leader: Norman
Specialty: Normal-type
Reward: Balance Badge, TM42

Method:
Return to Petalburg City for the fifth Gym. This gym has you face off against trainers by choosing rooms to get through a short quiz for Pokémon. You can defeat trainers as you go. At the end, you will find the player character's father, Norman. If you beat him you you get TM42 (Facade) and the Balance Badge. You can also Surf across water now.

Gym #6: Fortree City

Location: Fortree City
Gym Leader: Winona
Specialty: Flying-type
Reward: Feather Badge, TM40

Method:
This gym has a door puzzle you must solve before facing the Flying-type bird user Winona. This requires you to move the doors in order to get a path through the gym. At the end you can face Winonan and, if you win, you get TM40 (Aerial Ace) as well as the Feather Badge. You can also use the move Fly to get around on the map now.

Gym #7: Mossdeep City

Location: Mossdeep City
Gym Leader: Tate & Liza
Specialty: Psychic-type
Reward: Mind Badge, TM04

Method:
This gym has two Gym Leaders, Tate and Liza, who fight with Psychic-types in a Double Battle format. The main puzzle is to get through the gym using various warp tiles in order to reach Tate & Liza, battling trainers as you go through. If you win you get the Mind Badge along with TM04 (Calm Mind). Plus, you can Dive while Surfing on the water now.

Gym #8: Sootopolis City

Location: Sootopolis City
Gym Leader: Juan
Specialty: Water-type
Reward: Rain Badge, TM03

Method:
In a change to the original game, the Sootopolis City Gym is run by Juan. Here, the puzzle is largely the same where you have to go through a puzzle cracking the ice by walking on the tile no more than once. Fill all the tiles to get to the next floor. If you break a tile, you need to start over. At the end is Juan and, if you defeat him, you get TM03
